preservation: Every document key/scope/entry inventory retained. Every contract key outside citations/derivations/routine_steps retained exactly, including risk_review,boundaries,finite_smoke. Existing surviving citation and step row extra fields and ids retained. Retired annotated rows block their item update rather than deleting unrelated row fields. boundary_policy: Normalized old contract claim versus current proof paragraph differences are advisory; no claim of changed argument or renewed boundary review. Only missing step anchors on checked boundaries block. Missing anchors on not_applicable evidence are advisory; reason/status unchanged. Root-only narrow source-backed3field CAS is separate and must rebase if mirrors applied.
algorithm_policy: Root explicitly authorized opt-in exclusion of two obsolete proofless algorithm contract scope/key records only. The two algorithms remain in source/manifests/pages and separate property proof carriers remain registered. Opt-in archives full old entries; default remains advisory preserving original records. Actual isProofBearing and kind rechecked at application.
unused_citation_policy: Strict proof-contract.mjs requires every fact wikilink contracted and each citation nonempty correct uses. Keep true citation and actual uses[]; report for source owner actual proof-tag/unused-fact disposition. Do not fabricate a use or suppress source citation.
safety: Default reads only; --out creates a fresh research-only report/plan/candidate directory. Plan binds exact raw bytes of manifests,contracts,manifest items,actual fact suppliers and shared grammar inputs, without hashes. Explicit root application checks all current bytes,manifest inventory,output ownership,scope/inventory/protected fields, stages only contract JSON, then rechecks before rename. Application assumes root has drained writers; multiple metadata replacements are not a cross-file filesystem transaction. All source/frozen/native files untouched. Root final current-input binding remains required.
